summary.text: Conforti is the Republican nominee for Illinois' 6th District. She describes herself as a businesswoman and energy consultant who previously worked in healthcare administration and owned a staffing business. She ran for this seat in the 2022 primary and the 2024 general election, and won the March 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: According to her campaign website, she is a lifelong resident of the western suburbs of Chicago and a single mother, and comes from a family of military veterans.
Graduated from the University of Chicago School of Economics and earned an M.B.A. in healthcare administration from George Washington University.
According to her campaign website, she grew up in a family-owned business and later owned her own staffing business.
Worked for about 12 years on the administration side of large health systems, including as a director, and says she wrote corporate policy there.
Finished third in the June 2022 Republican primary for this seat with 11.4% of the vote (Keith Pekau won the nomination).
Won the March 2024 Republican primary and lost the November 2024 general election to Sean Casten, 54.2% to 45.8%.
Won the March 17, 2026 Republican primary with 82.2% of the vote over Skylar Duensing.
According to her campaign website, she has been involved in philanthropic efforts through her church and with International Orthodox Christian Charities and Mothers2Mothers.
